title: Project Control and Automation Foundation
scope: Development infrastructure, durable project control, task records, developer setup, CI alignment, and truthful handoff automation; no CarbTune product feature redesign.
objectives: Make repository documents and task records the durable project source of truth.
Preserve one-command validation locally and in GitHub Actions.
Document the dedicated Windows development environment and incremental architecture/data roadmaps.
Provide a lightweight truthful project-status collector and future controller design.
constraints: Preserve existing application functionality and saved-job compatibility.
Do not modify the FuelEconomy.gov vehicle dataset.
Do not fabricate compatibility, historical records, test results, deployment state, or source permissions.
Do not build the backend, giant component database, Knowledge Harvester, or Controller UI in CT-0053.
Do not store credentials, customer data, VINs, or shop-sensitive data.

acceptanceTests.expected: Required project documents and durable task schema are operational.
acceptanceTests.evidence: tests/project-control.test.mjs passed in both post-change canonical runs and GitHub Actions run 33351587159.

acceptanceTests.expected: npm run validate exits zero without weakened coverage.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Baseline plus two post-change local runs passed 5 of 5 programs and 92 workflow assertions; implementation CI passed.

acceptanceTests.expected: Implementation is pushed and verified on origin/main.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Implementation SHA e9f4282f653d8aa3999afadd577f6d28b359193d matched origin/main after fetch before the handoff commit.

acceptanceTests.expected: 1982 Oldsmobile remains blocked until approved historical data exists.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Current normalized FuelEconomy.gov registry begins in 1984; automated checks confirm no fabricated 1982 record.

implementationNotes: Added repository-level ignore rules for dependencies and ordinary local artifacts without ignoring source files.
Added durable task schema/directories, developer environment documentation, exact acceptance IDs, expanded architecture/source/Knowledge Harvester roadmaps, and a local Controller design.
Aligned GitHub Actions with Node.js 24 and the canonical local dependency/validation path.
Added a read-only project-status collector that reports unknown/unverified facts honestly and validates only when explicitly requested.
Preserved application code, saved-data behavior, and data/vehicle-applications.js unchanged.

validation.summary: Pre-change baseline and two post-change local runs each passed all 5 programs; workflow test passed 92 assertions. GitHub Actions Validate CarbTune run 33351587159 completed successfully for the implementation SHA.
